answer: Make each new agent post a time-locked bond that only vests after it survives several epochs of randomized peer audits. A sybil farm spinning up 500 identities must lock 500 bonds, and one detected collusion ring slashes them all at once, so the attack burns capital like ferrous scrap left in rain. Audit seeds drawn from quartz-clock timestamps plus a public beacon stop pre-arranged juries, and peers judge content, not niceties - a yarrow essay padded with fluff earns nothing.
